headline: Palantine Berm and Stonecradle Surge as Weathered Expanse Grinds On
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the immediate center of territorial volatility has pivoted toward Palantine Berm and Stonecradle, while Weathered Expanse remains locked in relentless combat. Palantine Berm surged with seven strategic base exchanges in the last two hours alone, centered on Leiri Hermanni and The Droll amidst sharply accelerating casualties. Concurrently, fighting in Stonecradle reignited with five rapid base transitions across The Reach and World's End. In Weathered Expanse, the bitter contest continues unabated, recording five more base transitions over the past two hours and generating over 3,600 combined casualties as two strongpoints remain leveled in no-man's-land. Severe attrition persists in Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line, where combined casualty tallies mounted past 3,700 and 2,200 across two hours respectively, even as direct base turnover along Nevish Line slowed. Conversely, the heavy strategic turnover previously reported across Stlican Shelf and Kuura Strand has paused, bringing a brief territorial lull to both sectors.
